issue_context.title: Simplify Hash transforms
issue_context.body:
Now that we support Ruby 2.5+ we can use `transform_values` and `transform_keys` to simplify and speedup some of our hash key/value manipulation.

```
/Users/tsmith/dev/work/chef/chef-config/lib/chef-config/mixin/train_transport.rb:47:11: C: Style/HashTransformKeys: Prefer transform_keys over map {...}.to_h.
          credentials[profile].map { |k, v| [k.to_sym, v] }.to_h # return symbolized keys to match Train.options()
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
/Users/tsmith/dev/work/chef/chef-config/lib/chef-config/workstation_config_loader.rb:169:31: C: Style/HashTransformKeys: Prefer transform_keys over Hash[_.map {...}].
          Config.knife.merge!(Hash[value.map { |k, v| [k.to_sym, v] }])
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
/Users/tsmith/dev/work/chef/lib/chef/provider/package/dpkg.rb:191:15: C: Style/HashTransformValues: Prefer transform_values over Hash[_.map {...}].
              Hash[name_pkginfo.map { |k, v| [k, v ? v.split("\t")[1].strip : nil] }]
              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
/Users/tsmith/dev/work/chef/lib/chef/provider/package/dpkg.rb:198:15: C: Style/HashTransformValues: Prefer transform_values over Hash[_.map {...}].
              Hash[name_pkginfo.map { |k, v| [k, v ? v.split("\t")[0] : nil] }]
              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
```
